checkpoints.description: [1/2] Attach project to AIKit and align README with PRINCIPLE-005 quick-reference and directory-tree rules

impact_assessment.why: The user asked to integrate this template library into AIKit so agents can cold-start, verify and deliver it under the principles
impact_assessment.benefits: Registered project memory, a cold-start quick reference, an accurate directory tree and a single Phase 4 gate command
impact_assessment.risks: contract: README gains required sections only; dependency: no runtime or toolchain added; concurrency: none; state: new .aikit/ memory plus ledger
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep template content untouched, validate with aikit.py check, and inspect the diff before delivery

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Integration verified: 4/4 project gates pass (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); checklists: passed

impact_assessment.why: The user asked to continue expanding the Anamnesis library using the literature
impact_assessment.benefits: Evidence-based questions and explanations for epilepsy, tremor, RLS, myokymia, MS/optic neuritis, Parkinson disease and syncope
impact_assessment.risks: contract: template wording and clinical scope; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: README catalogue and docs
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use ILAE, MDS, IRLSSG, McDonald, ESC and AAN sources, preserve the existing Turkish template style, and run the project gates
